In 2026, a kitchen renovation in West Vancouver, BC costs between $29,000 for a cosmetic refresh and $130,000+ for a full luxury kitchen. A mid-range kitchen renovation in West Vancouver — replacing cabinets, countertops, appliances, and flooring — typically runs $45,000–$75,000. High-end projects with custom millwork, premium appliances, and structural changes can reach $90,000–$130,000. Reno Stars has completed kitchen projects in West Vancouver using real completed-project budgets.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Cost in West Vancouver in 2026

  • Property values — West Vancouver homes are among the most expensive in Canada. Kitchens in this price range represent a smaller percentage of home value, but the absolute dollar amounts are high because kitchen sizes are large (often 200–400+ sq ft) and client expectations are set by the property's standard.
  • Premium finishes — West Vancouver clients typically specify premium materials: custom cabinetry rather than stock, natural stone rather than quartz for some applications, European appliances (Miele, Sub-Zero, Wolf), and designer fixtures. These add $20,000–$50,000 over mid-range equivalents.
  • Older housing stock — West Vancouver has a significant number of homes built in the 1960s–1980s, often with original kitchens. These homes frequently need electrical upgrades (knob-and-tube wiring is common in older West Van homes), plumbing re-routing, and subfloor replacement — all of which add cost.
  • Building permits — West Vancouver falls under the District of West Vancouver's Building Department. Any changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements require a permit. Heritage-designated homes (common in West Vancouver) require additional heritage review for exterior-visible changes.
  • Landscaping and site access — Many West Vancouver properties are on steep slopes, limiting site access for material delivery and requiring crane or specialized equipment for large appliance or material delivery. This can add $2,000–$8,000 to a project.

West Vancouver Kitchen Renovation: Permit Requirements

In the District of West Vancouver, a building permit is required for kitchen renovations that involve:

  • Any changes to plumbing locations (moving a sink, dishwasher, or gas cooktop)
  • Electrical work beyond simple fixture replacement (adding circuits for new appliances, under-cabinet lighting, or EV charging)
  • Structural changes including removal of load-bearing walls or modifications to the roof structure
  • Any work that alters the exterior appearance of the home (heritage-designated homes)
  • Installation of a gas appliance (cooktop, oven, fireplace)

Cosmetic-only work — repainting, installing a new faucet, replacing cabinet doors — typically does not require a permit in West Vancouver. Reno Stars manages all District of West Vancouver permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions — West Vancouver Kitchen Renovation

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in West Vancouver in 2026?

A kitchen renovation in West Vancouver costs between $29,000 for a cosmetic refresh and $130,000+ for a full luxury kitchen with custom everything. A mid-range kitchen renovation in West Vancouver — replacing all cabinetry, countertops, appliances, and flooring — typically runs $45,000–$75,000. All prices from completed Reno Stars projects include labour, materials, permits where required, and our 3-year workmanship warranty.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in West Vancouver?

You need a permit in West Vancouver for any plumbing relocation, electrical upgrades, structural changes, or installation of a gas appliance. Cosmetic work — repainting, replacing cabinet doors, or installing a new faucet in the same location — typically does not require a permit. Heritage-designated homes require additional heritage review for any exterior-visible changes. Reno Stars handles all District of West Vancouver permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

Why are West Vancouver kitchen renovations more expensive than other cities?

West Vancouver kitchen renovation costs are higher due to larger kitchen sizes (200–400+ sq ft), premium client expectations for custom finishes and European appliances, older housing stock that often needs electrical and plumbing upgrades, challenging terrain that can affect site access, and higher labour rates in the District of West Vancouver.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in West Vancouver?

A cosmetic kitchen refresh in West Vancouver takes 2–3 weeks. A mid-range full renovation takes 6–10 weeks. A high-end luxury kitchen with custom millwork and premium appliances takes 10–18 weeks. A luxury kitchen with structural changes can take 16–26 weeks.
